_meta.status: Dispatch Engine v1. Seeded estimates, not NEMSIS data.
_meta.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: every weight below is a seeded estimate.
_meta.samplerRule: The sampler draws 0 to 1 archetype: 25% no bystander on arrival, else one archetype weighted by weight within minLevel <= level. helpsWith 'holding_pressure' stages bystander pressure at instantiation when a femoral bleed is present.

archetypes.label: Witnessing driver holding pressure
archetypes.behavior: Stopped to help, holds a shirt on the wound, answers short and stays out of the way once you take over.
sampleLines: I put my shirt on it - it just keeps coming.
Tell me where you want me.
archetypes.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Mirrors the Bike down opener.

archetypes.label: Helpful off-duty nurse
archetypes.behavior: Calm, gives a crisp handoff (onset, meds, allergies), offers hands but never takes over your call.
sampleLines: Onset was about ten minutes ago. He takes metoprolol - that is all I know.
Want me to hold that while you work?

archetypes.label: Panicked spouse
archetypes.behavior: Hovers, cries, answers in fragments, needs one clear job or keeps crowding your workspace.
sampleLines: He was fine - he was just - I do not know what happened!

archetypes.label: Caller gone, quiet house
archetypes.behavior: Nobody on scene. The 911 caller hung up and left the door open. You work alone with the patient.
archetypes.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Tests solo assessment and history-taking from the patient alone.

archetypes.label: Lying roommate
archetypes.behavior: Called 911 but hides the drugs. Story changes when you ask twice. The scene clues contradict him.
sampleLines: He just - fell asleep, man. I do not know about any pills.
Those are not his - I mean - somebody left those here.
archetypes.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Built for overdose calls.

archetypes.label: Hostile crowd
archetypes.behavior: Films everything, shouts advice, closes in. One loud voice leads; the rest follow. PD is coming but not here.
sampleLines: Yo, you are hurting him! I am recording this!
Back up? We live here - hurry up!

archetypes.label: Family with a language barrier
archetypes.behavior: Caring, frantic, almost no English. Points, mimes, shows a pill bottle and a phone with a translate app that barely works.
sampleLines: [rapid speech in another language, pointing at the pill bottle]
[holds up phone: TRANSLATE - pain... chest... morning?]

archetypes.label: Drunk friend talking over everyone
archetypes.behavior: Means well, slurs, interrupts the patient and you, contradicts himself about times and amounts.
sampleLines: We had like - two beers - okay maybe more, but he is fine, he is - oh no.
Let me tell you what happened - no wait, ask me, I saw the whole thing.
